item.title: Nonstop sirens in north as IDF expands Lebanon operation; US: Iran may emerge emboldened
item.description: Sirens sound in northern Israel as IDF expands ground operation in Lebanon; US intelligence assesses Iran’s regime likely to survive and emerge emboldened despite ongoing war and regional escalation

item.title: Israeli crashes Turkish reporter’s live broadcast — video goes viral
item.description: CNN Türk reporter broadcast about missile strikes from Iran and 'panic' in Israel; an Israeli who recognized him on the street burst into the live broadcast and addressed him in Turkish: 'What nonsense are you talking about?'

item.title: קלוד תחת אש: טראמפ רוצה לזרוק, אבל הצבא חייב אותו
item.description: אחרי שהקריס את המניות של ענקיות הטק והציב איום על פרנסתם של המתכנתים, מודל ה–AI "קלוד" מחולל מהפכה גם במלחמה עם איראן ועוזר לצבא האמריקאי לשפר את הביצועים. אנת'רופיק, המפתחת שלו, מתעקשת להגדיר קווים מוסריים לשימוש בו ומוציאה את טראמפ מהכלים

item.title: Iran cluster missile barrages hit central Israel, damages train station and buildings; no injuries reported
item.description: Three waves of cluster missiles fired from Iran triggers sirens across central Israel and Jerusalem; damage reported in Holon, Tel Aviv, Or Yehuda and Rinatya as interception debris falls, but no casualties reported | See photos and video

item.title: US mobilizes global pressure on Iran, tells diplomats to coordinate with Israel
item.description: Marco Rubio ordered American diplomats to reach out to foreign governments, amid the attempt to mobilize a coalition that would lead to the opening of the Strait of Hormuz; 'Information efforts should be coordinated with Israeli diplomatic counterparts,' the cable obtained by ...

item.title: Militia leader tied to Elizabeth Tsurkov’s captivity killed in Iraq
item.description: Abu Ali al-Askari, a senior commander in the Iran-backed Hezbollah Brigades in Iraq, was reportedly killed in an airstrike; former captive Elizabeth Tsurkov said he was personally involved in holding her captive and spreading false claims about her

item.title: Jewish extremists attack IDF forces evacuating West Bank outpost, injuring soldier
item.description: Troops that arrived to evacuate illegal structures at bypass junction near Hebron were met with severe violence; assailants threw two large rocks: one hit a bulldozer, shattering its windshield and injuring the driver

item.title: Living in secret apartments, not leaving home: Threats against Israeli ambassadors abroad increasing
item.description: Warnings of harm to Israeli diplomats have increased, even purchasing food requires prior approval; diplomats tell ynet: 'There is real fear for our lives, how do you explain to a child that he can't go down and play?

item.title: Iran’s ‘Game of Thrones’: Report reveals drama behind Mojtaba Khamenei’s selection as supreme leader
item.description: NYT publishes details about the process of electing Mojtaba Khamenei as Iran's supreme leader; before his death, Ali Khamenei gave his close advisers three names as potential successors, his son was not among them

item.title: צה"ל זיהה היערכות של חיזבאללה למטחים גדולים; ייתכן גם ירי משולב עם איראן
item.description: אחרי שבשבוע שעבר נמנעו מלעדכן את הציבור, בצה"ל הודיעו כי ארגון הטרור מתכונן למטחים שיכוונו כנראה לצפון. בצבא מנסים לשבש את הירי גם בתקיפות, ראש מועצה לתושביו: "זה יקרה סביב 19:00". פיקוד העורף יעדכן מראש לשהות ליד מרחב מוגן. בפעם הקודמת זה הסתיים ב-220 רקטות וכטב"מים, ורק 2 נפלו
